manifest.hypothesis: [CPU] Indicator RPT-1 (algorithmic recurrence) as a functional property; RPT-2 is not targeted (doc 38): does algorithmic recurrence with a persistent latent state across steps (the latent recurrence of docs/architecture/01-ptr-core.md, model/burn-a0 latent_steps) integrate multi-step evidence better than a parameter- and FLOP-matched feed-forward stack with unshared layers, on a task whose answer depends on a state carried across steps? Toy task: a modular counter (the running sum modulo six of a sequence of symbols, supervised after every step); training sequences have 2 to 6 steps, the answer is asked at 6 steps (in distribution), at 12 steps (primary, twice the longest trained), 18 and 24. Arms: a gated recurrent net with a carried state; a causal feed-forward stack of unshared attention layers with relative-position bias (parameters matched within 2% and FLOPs within 10% at 6 steps, the depth, slope scale and learning rate tuned on pilot seeds with recorded rules); the recurrent net with the carried state reset at every step (ablation, a floor by construction). An extrapolation-removed control: the same stack trained with the 12-step length in its pool must recover more than half of the recurrent arm's advantage. Sensitivity controls: the recurrent net trained on permuted labels (gross), the trained recurrent net on corrupted inputs (graded, a known deficit of the margin's order); null worlds in which recurrence can have no advantage (permuted labels for both arms, and the sum of the last two steps only). Stage A of the CPU part of C004; the GPU stage B (recurrent state in OLMoE-class experts) is not registered here. Targets indicator RPT-1 only (not RPT-L1 or RPT-L2). Functional mechanism test only: it says nothing about consciousness or about language models.
manifest.metrics: accuracy at 12 steps (primary); accuracy at 6 (in distribution), 18 and 24 steps; accuracy against the number of steps (6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 24; descriptive); parameter and FLOP counts per arm; state-carryover probe (does the read-out change when the first step is replaced: recurrent, feed-forward, reset-state; the true answer always changes); paired per-seed differences with one-sided 95% t bounds (lower and upper) over fourteen seeds; validity guards; sensitivity controls; null worlds
manifest.baseline: parameter- and FLOP-matched causal feed-forward stack with unshared layers (judged); the recurrent net with the carried state reset every step (judged, a floor by construction); the same stack trained on the 12-step length (extrapolation-removed control); the label-permuted and corrupted-input recurrent nets as gross and graded sensitivity controls; null worlds with permuted labels and with a two-step window
manifest.falsification: Four outcomes, decided in advance (PREREGISTRATION.md, criteria.toml). COMPLETED if the guards and controls hold and both lower one-sided 95% t bounds over the fourteen paired seed differences of 12-step accuracy (recurrent minus feed-forward, recurrent minus reset-state) are at least 100 per mille. FALSIFIED (refuted) only if the guards and controls hold and some Bonferroni upper bound is below 100 per mille; and structurally FALSIFIED if a structural counter is above 0 on a valid seed (the reset-state ablation carries information over an early step, the feed-forward stack is not causal, nondeterminism) or a coverage rule fails. NOT_SHOWN if the bounds straddle the margin. INVALID, never falsified, if parameter or FLOP counts differ beyond the pinned tolerance (2% and 10%) or any other integrity counter is above 0, the feed-forward comparator is saturated (at or above 980 per mille) or did not learn the training distribution (below 800) on more than one seed, the recurrent arm did not, a judged arm hit the step cap on more than one seed, a sensitivity control, the extrapolation-removed control or a null world is not resolved as required, or the seeds or mutation evidence are missing; INVALID precedes every FALSIFIED and COMPLETED branch.
